content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Research Associate Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Associate: Requires Ph.D. degree in Mechanical, Civil, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience with finite element modeling, plasticity desirable. Strong background in finite element methods, plasticity theory, crystal plasticity, solid mechanics. Familiarity with programming in Python/Matlab/C++. Familiarity with finite element software like Abaqus, Moose, Ansys etc.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Research Associate Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Research Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 16-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 16th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. degree in Mechanical, Civil, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline. Specific experience in finite element modeling and plasticity is also desirable.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Associate post at IIT Delhi as per the released notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000/- per month plus HRA at 27%.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through email. Candidates need to send their complete application and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Delhi Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and then invited for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Research Associate position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the IIT Delhi located?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi is located in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly.
